## RE:volution Mod v1.4.5

### Added

- Added `RuneEffectBalanceService` so existing Poison rune effects resolve their parameters from the active Balance Core snapshot.
- Added canonical effect definitions for existing Poison groups, tags, effect types, target selectors, rank-specific values, and per-effect enhancement steps.
- Added data-driven parameters for targeted power, proc chance and multiplier, rage multiplier/duration/max stacks, and reward bonuses.
- Added regression coverage for the bundled Poison baseline and Balance Core effect resolution.

### Fixed

- Rune combat no longer relies on local Java numeric hardcode for effect power when the value is present in canonical balance data.
- Reward bonus resolution now uses the same active `BalanceService` snapshot as the rest of the rune economy.
- Rank scaling is no longer derived from the old hardcoded `NORMAL=1`, `IMPROVED=3`, `ADVANCED=9` switch in the effect path; equivalent values are now supplied by canonical definitions.
- Enhancement scaling for migrated effects no longer depends on the local `0.1` constant in the gameplay path.

### Other

- This release intentionally preserves the current Poison gameplay baseline and does not introduce new rune mechanics.
- Existing targeted-power mappings, the hidden-strike proc baseline, rage behavior, and reward-bonus behavior are retained while their parameters become data-driven.
- No Mongo schema migration or network wire-format change is required.
- Player-controlled Rune Rank Revert is not part of v1.4.5 and remains planned separately for v1.4.9.
- Mob Balance remains the next Balance Layer migration stage in v1.4.6.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifact published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.4.4...v1.4.5
